visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair tied back, wearing a pink and white varsity jacket over a white top, smiles excitedly at the camera. She holds a small plastic resealable bag containing dried ginseng roots and points toward a large cardboard box filled with more roots. The setting is indoors with vertical wooden paneling behind her. (2) The scene cuts to an industrial processing facility where several workers wearing blue gloves and casual clothing are sorting through massive piles of dried ginseng roots on a large metal platform. In the background, heavy machinery and blue conveyor belts are visible in a brightly lit factory setting. (3) A different woman with long blonde hair, wearing a grey vest over a black blazer and red pants, stands in a large warehouse. She wears a white sash with 'ALICE IN DAIRYLAND' printed on it. She waves enthusiastically to the camera while holding a smartphone. Large wooden crates are stacked high in the background. (4) The camera shows a bright, modern interior space, possibly an airport or a botanical garden, with large indoor trees and glass facades. People are seen walking in the background. Then, back in the factory, workers are seen at a blue sorting table under bright overhead fluorescent lights, meticulously picking through the harvest. (5) In a warehouse, two men in caps and work clothes empty bags of ginseng into a large wooden bin while a conveyor belt operates above them. The sash-wearing woman then holds up a large, multi-limbed ginseng root toward the camera with a wide smile. (6) Two large white industrial garage doors slowly roll upward to reveal long, narrow white-walled drying corridors. The woman in the sash is seen walking down one of these corridors. The lighting is flat and functional. (7) Outdoor shots depict a vast, muddy field with rows of brown, withered ginseng plants under a grey, overcast sky. Black shading structures on poles are seen stretching across the landscape. (8) Back indoors, a man in a red jacket shows dried roots on wooden racks in a specialized drying room. The sash-wearing woman is also present, inspecting the produce. Finally, top-down shots show ginseng powder being scooped and prepared, followed by a dark bowl of black chicken soup with dates and chestnuts.
